# Figure S1 | Replicate check

<!-- Generated by fig_s1_replicates.py from the campaign CSVs; do not edit by hand (re-run the script). -->

**Figure S1 | Replicate check: seeding is fast in both runs; the unseeded plateau did not replicate.**

**(a)** Best IRR found so far against simulated trials (log scale) for the two unseeded (uninformed) profitability campaigns and the two seeded (TRY-informed) ones. Solid lines are this work's campaigns: the uninformed campaign and the TRY-informed campaign seeded with 1,000 trials of the six TRY scouts (592 isobutanol-scout and 408 ethanol-scout trials: all 327 scout trials at least as profitable as the starting strain by profitability index, plus 673 space-filling ones). Dashed lines are replicates: an uninformed campaign (run 2026-09-16) whose 50-trial space-filling start-up design, shared with seven replicate scouts, differs from this work's (51 trials, shared with the six scouts), and a TRY-informed campaign (run 2026-09-23) seeded with 1,000 trials of those seven scouts (451 isobutanol-scout, 348 ethanol-scout and 201 price-weighted-yield trials). Open circles: first trial with IRR ≥ 25 %; stars and diamonds: each campaign's best design (filled for this work, open for the replicate). Italic labels give the products of every best-so-far design of the two unseeded campaigns (co-producing = at least 5 g·L⁻¹ each of isobutanol and ethanol; ethanol only = less than 5 g·L⁻¹ isobutanol). The table above the axes gives, for each pair, this work / replicate.

**(b)** The seven replicate scouts, drawn as in panel c of the main figure: every completed trial (dots), the best-IRR trial visited (open marker), the design returned (filled marker; argmax of the campaign's own objective) and their connector. Marker shape gives the objective: circle yield, square titer, triangle productivity. The dashed line and the tint mark this work's uninformed plateau (15.8 %), kept as the reference; the table counts trials above it and gives the returned design's IRR.

**What replicates.**

* Seeded search passed 25 % within 18 and 19 trials and reached 27.3 % and 27.1 % (trials 913 and 824). After 25 trials the seeded campaigns stood at 26.2 % and 25.6 %; the unseeded ones at −11.2 % (a loss) and 9.6 %. The replicate's seeds already contained a 25.1 % design (its isobutanol-yield scout's best visit, vs 22.9 % for this work); its first simulated trial above that was trial 19.
* The isobutanol scouts visited designs above 15.8 % (92, 2 and 5 trials for yield, titer and productivity; price-weighted yield 46), while the ethanol scouts never did (best 15.3 %).
* Every scout returned a design below the uninformed plateau (highest: 15.5 %).
* All three campaigns that passed 27 % returned co-production designs: this work's TRY-informed 39.6 g·L⁻¹ isobutanol + 40.6 g·L⁻¹ ethanol; replicate TRY-informed 42.9 g·L⁻¹ + 11.3 g·L⁻¹; replicate uninformed 41.7 g·L⁻¹ + 29.2 g·L⁻¹.

**What does not replicate.**

* The unseeded plateau. Every improvement of this work's uninformed campaign was an ethanol-only design (all 19 best-so-far steps; first profitable at trial 53), and it stayed at 15.8 % from trial 104 to trial 2,000. The replicate's space-filling start-up already contained a profitable co-production design (trial 12: 9.6 % with 28.0 g·L⁻¹ isobutanol + 62.1 g·L⁻¹ ethanol), and every later improvement kept co-producing (all 21 steps): it passed 15.8 % at trial 64 (17.2 %; 11.8 g·L⁻¹ + 110.2 g·L⁻¹), 25 % at trial 104 (25.1 %; 30.7 g·L⁻¹ + 46.7 g·L⁻¹) and 27.3 % only at trial 1,603.
* In both unseeded runs every improvement kept the product class of the first profitable design, so in these two runs unseeded success tracked the start-up design (1 of 2 runs stayed on the ethanol-only plateau); seeded search was fast in 2 of 2.

"Trial" is the simulated index (preloaded seeds excluded); only completed trials are used. IRRs are at default prices; a loss (IRR < 0, or no IRR for an outright money-loser) is drawn in the grey band. The replicate uninformed and scout campaigns ran before the model version was pinned; the replicate uninformed campaign's best design re-simulated to within 3 × 10⁻⁴ IRR of its recorded value.
